rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for permanently leaving work because of age or illness.

example.english: I plan to retire at fifty.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 ng5 sap6 seoi3 zau6 teoi3 jau1

rows.note: Use this specifically when an athlete stops competing in their sport.

example.english: They will retire from competition after this season because of a knee injury.
example.traditional: 佢膝頭有傷，今季之後就退役。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 tau4 jau5 soeng1 gam1 gwai3 zi1 hau6 zau6 teoi3 jik6
